title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
description:
A sorted array of **unique** integers was rotated between 1 and `n` times, so `[0,1,2,4,5,6,7]` might become `[4,5,6,7,0,1,2]`.

Given the rotated array `nums`, return its minimum element. Your algorithm must run in **O(log n)** time.

examples.explanation: The original array was [1,2,3,4,5], rotated 3 times.

hints: Compare the middle element with the rightmost element to decide which half is still sorted.
The minimum lies in the half that is not sorted.
